// FCM high-priority DATA message receiver; builds user-visible call notification immediately.
// Never starts background microphone or camera. Generated by scripts/configure-native.mjs.
package __PACKAGE__;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.media.AudioAttributes;
import android.media.RingtoneManager;
import android.net.Uri;
import android.os.Build;
import com.google.firebase.messaging.FirebaseMessagingService;
import com.google.firebase.messaging.RemoteMessage;
import java.util.Map;

public final class NativeVoipMessageService extends FirebaseMessagingService {
    public static final int INCOMING_NOTIFICATION_ID=2968;
    private static final String CHANNEL_ID="love_radar_native_incoming_v1";

    @Override public void onNewToken(String fcmToken){
        super.onNewToken(fcmToken);
        NativeVoipPlugin.tokenChanged(this,fcmToken);
    }

    @Override public void onMessageReceived(RemoteMessage message){
        super.onMessageReceived(message);
        Map<String,String> data=message.getData();
        if(!"incoming_call".equals(data.get("type")))return;
        String id=data.get("callId");
        if(id==null||!id.matches("(?i)[0-9a-f-]{36}"))return;
        long expires;
        try{expires=Long.parseLong(data.get("expiresAt"));}
        catch(Exception ignored){return;}
        long remaining=expires-System.currentTimeMillis();
        if(remaining<=0||remaining>120000)return;
        NotificationManager manager=(NotificationManager)getSystemService(NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        if(manager==null)return;
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=33&&
           checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)!=PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED){
            // Android cannot bypass a user's notification preference for incoming calls.
            return;
        }
        createChannel(manager);
        String caller=data.get("callerName");
        if(caller==null||caller.trim().isEmpty())caller="Ton partenaire";
        caller=caller.replaceAll("[\\r\\n\\t<>]","").trim();
        if(caller.length()>60)caller=caller.substring(0,60);
        String mode="video".equals(data.get("mode"))?"video":"audio";
        Intent incoming=new Intent(this,NativeIncomingCallActivity.class);
        incoming.setFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK|Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP|
            Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_CLEAR_TOP);
        incoming.putExtra("callId",id);
        incoming.putExtra("callerName",caller);
        incoming.putExtra("expiresAt",expires);
        incoming.putExtra("mode",mode);
        int flags=PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT|PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE;
        PendingIntent fullScreen=PendingIntent.getActivity(this,INCOMING_NOTIFICATION_ID,incoming,flags);
        Notification.Builder notification=Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=26
          ?new Notification.Builder(this,CHANNEL_ID)
          :new Notification.Builder(this);
        notification.setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.sym_call_incoming)
          .setContentTitle("Love Radar · Appel entrant")
          .setContentText("Appuie pour répondre à ton partenaire")
          .setCategory(Notification.CATEGORY_CALL)
          .setPriority(Notification.PRIORITY_MAX)
          .setAutoCancel(true)
          .setContentIntent(fullScreen)
          .setVisibility(Notification.VISIBILITY_PRIVATE)
          .setVibrate(new long[]{0,280,180,280,400,280})
          .setOnlyAlertOnce(true);
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=26)notification.setTimeoutAfter(Math.min(remaining,60000));
        else notification.setSound(RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_RINGTONE));
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT<34||manager.canUseFullScreenIntent()){
            notification.setFullScreenIntent(fullScreen,true);
        }
        try{manager.notify(INCOMING_NOTIFICATION_ID,notification.build());}
        catch(SecurityException ignored){
            // If permission was revoked, never crash the process or create a silent call.
        }
    }

    private void createChannel(NotificationManager manager){
        if(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT<26)return;
        NotificationChannel channel=new NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID,
            "Love Radar · appels entrants",NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH);
        channel.setDescription("Sonnerie des appels vocaux et vidéo entrants");
        channel.enableVibration(true);
        channel.setVibrationPattern(new long[]{0,280,180,280,400,280});
        Uri ringtone=RingtoneManager.getDefaultUri(RingtoneManager.TYPE_RINGTONE);
        channel.setSound(ringtone,new AudioAttributes.Builder()
           .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE)
           .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION).build());
        channel.setLockscreenVisibility(Notification.VISIBILITY_PRIVATE);
        manager.createNotificationChannel(channel);
    }
}
